translated: Between the last Leoni event and how quiet things have been lately, I'm really worried.
I'll wish on a shooting star that the Leoni girls' hearts will clear up as soon as possible!
Thank you so much.
Yeah, you're right.
When a normally energetic person starts to feel... how should I put it...
When they're feeling down, it's that contrast...
Even in everyday life, when you see someone acting differently than usual,
that gap in their personality makes you extra worried about them, doesn't it?
It's just like you wrote. Saki-chan is usually the type to...
She's very headstrong. When she wants to do something, she just goes for it.
The rest of Leoni usually gives her a bit of a hard time about it,
especially Shiho-chan, who sighs and says "Good grief," but they all...
They all go along with her, and she really brightens up the room.
I feel like that's Saki-chan's role, but this time,
at the end of the story... those feelings that started to bud...
I don't know what happens after this myself, but...
In this story, she makes the choice not to say anything for now.
I mean,
I don't know if I should just call it a "gap" in her personality.
The fact that Saki-chan... that Saki-chan would make this choice...
It's...
It's quite surprising.
But it shows just how much she cares about everyone in Leoni.
Of course, it's been shown in the stories leading up to this, like Shiho-chan's...
Everyone's resolve toward their dream of turning professional and everything.
Because she treasures those feelings, she arrived at this choice.
I really feel the same way...
I just want to watch over Saki-chan as a fan myself.
